pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Patches exhibit a stellate or leaf-like geometry with highly irregular, serrated edge gradients. Individual dark regions are sub-polygonal with fine-grained projections interdigitating with the light interstitial spaces. Spatial area of patches is maximal on the upper flank and diminishes toward the ventral line.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological graph of light-toned pathways. Intersections are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank, providing clear separation between all adjacent dark regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents as a continuous, reddish-brown 1D geometric contour along the upper neck. The silhouette shows a high-frequency, low-amplitude serration consisting of dense, vertical hair-clump peaks against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent vertical skin folds and deep creases are visible in the lower neck and shoulder region, causing localized geometric compression and textural distortion of the patch-and-corridor pattern.
